topic: Day 39 — carousel — Real safety means no performance recovery needed after vulnerability

slides.text: It's not the absence of hard conversations.
It's not needing to fix how you looked after one.
Anxious repair afterward means it wasn't safe yet.

caption:
Real safety in a relationship isn't the absence of hard conversations. It's not needing to immediately fix how you looked after having one.
